criteria.description: A controllable vehicle, visible 3D track and start state
Forward input visibly increases vehicle displacement
Braking visibly reduces motion relative to a matched no-brake segment
Left and right steering change the path through track turns
Third-person camera follows the moving/turning vehicle
Inner and outer track boundaries prevent shortcut traversal
Visible checkpoint progress is ordered and cannot be bypassed
One legal lap finishes and freezes the displayed final time
Restart restores vehicle, timer and checkpoint progress
Player/track geometry and game information remain legible
Visible instructions and restart controls match observed behavior
Visible feedback distinguishes interactions and terminal states
Requested visual style and unobstructed desktop/mobile-size layout
Observed delivery duration gated by demonstrated basic gameplay
